lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters arranged in a staggered grid pattern along the mid-lateral flank. Clusters exhibit larger diameters and higher intensity in the region between the primary and secondary horizontal ridges.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with horizontal rows of blobs, creating a discernible node-based grid across the central flank posterior to the fifth gill slit.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal linear features running longitudinally; characterized by high-intensity specular highlights on the dorsal-facing edge and significant pixel-value drop-off (shadowing) on the ventral-facing edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Discrete high-luminance blobs distributed across the visible surface of the first dorsal fin, showing a higher spatial frequency and smaller diameter relative to the mid-flank blobs.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Two distinct, roughly parallel, high-intensity linear marks resembling abrasions located on the upper lateral flank, posterior to the gill region and superior to the mid-lateral ridge.
other_distinctive_markers: Pectoral fin displays a dense field of small, high-luminance spots that transition from a scattered arrangement at the base to a more uniform, high-frequency distribution toward the distal margin.
